title: Sample-weighted KV pinning + publish workflow for sequence-distribution profiles
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Model onboarding currently publishes a single static KV cache profile that doesn’t account for the actual sequence-length mix seen in customer traffic. That causes suboptimal pin decisions for long-tail models (either over-pinning expensive profiles or under-pinning causing high miss rates).
goal: Produce a repeatable workflow that: (1) samples and weights telemetry by sequence-length buckets, (2) generates a sequence-distribution-aware candidate pin for each model version, (3) validates candidate pins with synthetic replay and guardrail checks, and (4) publishes profiles to the model catalog with TTL/version pin metadata and rollback hooks.
acceptance_criteria:
1) A sampling job produces per-model sequence-length histograms and a normalized weight vector (buckets: 0-128,129-512,513-2048,2049-8192,>8192) stored in model metadata.
2) The pinning job produces a candidate profile with fields: pinned_kernel_variant, batch_target, kv_retention_ms, expected_miss_rate_estimate, and sample-weighted cost delta.
3) Candidate is validated by synthetic-replay against a small replay shard (>= 5k requests) with pass/fail thresholds: miss_rate <= baseline + 2% and median latency <= baseline + 10ms.
4) Publishing step writes profile to model-catalog with publish_timestamp, author, and TTL and exposes a rollback token.
5) End-to-end pipeline is automated in CI with an idempotent run, documented in the design doc, and covered by unit + integration tests.
testing_plan:
1) Unit tests for sampling/weight math and histogram bucketing.
2) Integration test: run pipeline on recorded traffic shard (2026-01-traffic-shard-07) and assert validation thresholds.
3) Staging canary deploy: publish profile with canary flag to dedicated staging pool, monitor miss_rate and latency for 48h.
4) Load test: synthetic traffic generator to exercise >95th percentile seq-lengths and confirm expected cost delta matches estimate within 15%.
rollout_plan:
- Step 1: Run pipeline nightly for non-production catalog to collect profiles and surface candidates in Console.
- Step 2: Manual review by SRE + Model Onboarding PM for first 10 models.
- Step 3: Enable automated publish for low-risk models (no high-privacy tags) with 24h canary and automatic rollback on SLO breach.
- Step 4: Gradually expand to all models with monitoring and runbook.
notes: We will reuse the synthetic-replay harness from ENG-9187 but add sequence-weighted scoring.
Consider storing per-bucket quantiles to detect distribution shifts; may add as follow-up (low effort).
Disk space: sampling shard retention adds ~200MB per 1k models per week; coordinate with infra for retention policy.
